mechanisms.label: a future change the price does not include yet
mechanisms.test: Is the change planned, announced or built, and do comparable prices already reflect it (priced in) or not yet?
mechanisms.basis: Capozza & Helsley 1989; Titman 1985; Plantinga et al. 2002; Mohammad et al. 2013

mechanisms.label: information the market lacks or does not trust
mechanisms.test: Which fact about this item is known to few buyers, and do comparables with that fact sell higher?

mechanisms.label: the market prices a coarse class while the truth is finer
mechanisms.test: Does the discount of the coarse class apply to this exact variant, or has its cause been fixed or never applied here?

mechanisms.label: an unfashionable or ignored segment
mechanisms.test: Is demand for this segment low for reasons that do not affect the asked purpose, compared with comparables?
mechanisms.basis: Butler 1980 tourism area life cycle; Hu, Pavlou & Zhang 2017

mechanisms.label: a real defect or risk the low price correctly reflects
mechanisms.test: Which evidence would show the low price is deserved, and is it present on the item?

admiralty.basis: NATO STANAG 2511 / Admiralty code; trust learned per host as in TruthFinder (Yin, Han & Yu 2008)
